description: This file defines a ViewModel for a tic-tac-toe game, managing game state, handling user interactions, persisting state across configuration changes, and determining game outcomes.

classes.name: Player
classes.description: Enumeration representing players X and O with their symbols.

classes.name: GameStatus
classes.description: Enumeration indicating the current state of the game: Playing, XWon, OWon, or Draw.

classes.name: GameViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel class managing the tic-tac-toe game state, user interactions, and persistence.

methods.name: onCellTap
methods.description: Handles a tap on the game board at the specified index, updating game state accordingly.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game to its initial state.

methods.name: checkWin
methods.description: Checks if a specified player has a winning line on the board.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Saves the current game state into SavedStateHandle.
